rows.quote: STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: We analyzed plasma levels of 2,922 proteins in 32,493 UK Biobank participants (53% female; mean [SD] age, 57 [8] years) to investigate their associations with spirometry measures of lung function (FEV1, FVC, FEV1 to FVC ratio), and with obstructive (n = 4,713) and restrictive (n = 3,886) spirometry patterns.
rows.coder_note: Step 3 (rule C): the authors' own analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data, defined by more than a number of participants (2,922 plasma proteins against spirometry measures and obstructive/restrictive spirometry patterns); no release, accession or citation of a dictionary row. No accession.
